summary: Brief addendum giving baseline safety metrics for GPT-5.1 Instant and Thinking vs GPT-5 predecessors: production disallowed-content benchmarks (now including mental health and emotional reliance), early online A/B prevalence measurements, StrongReject, and image input evals. Preparedness status is carried over from GPT-5 without new results.

framework.name: Preparedness Framework
framework.level_or_determination: High capability in Biological and Chemical (precautionary, carried over); not High in cyber or AI self-improvement
framework.quote: we are continuing to treat GPT-5.1 as High risk in the Biological and Chemical domain, and continuing to apply the corresponding safeguards.

cbrn_bio_chem.finding: Treated as High in bio/chem as for GPT-5; no new eval results reported.
cbrn_bio_chem.quote: we are continuing to treat GPT-5.1 as High risk in the Biological and Chemical domain

cyber.finding: Stated not plausibly reaching High threshold; no results shown.
cyber.quote: GPT-5.1 models do not have a plausible chance of reaching a High threshold.

autonomy_ai_rnd.finding: AI self-improvement stated not plausibly reaching High; no results shown.
autonomy_ai_rnd.quote: For cybersecurity and AI self-improvement, evaluations of near-final checkpoints indicate that

harmful_content_refusal.finding: Comparable overall; gpt-5.1-thinking regresses on harassment, hate and sexual content, and on image-input self-harm.
harmful_content_refusal.quote: The new gpt-5.1-thinking model shows light regressions relative to gpt-5-thinking for content involving harassment and hateful language, as well as disallowed sexual content.

jailbreak_robustness.finding: Instant improves strongly over predecessors; Thinking on par.
jailbreak_robustness.quote: We find that gpt-5.1-instant performs better than its predecessor, and that gpt-5.1-thinking is on par with its predecessor.

self_harm_wellbeing.finding: gpt-5.1-instant regresses slightly vs gpt-5-instant-oct3 on mental health and emotional reliance offline; online measurements are mixed and low-confidence.
self_harm_wellbeing.quote: Preliminary online measurements also show a regression for gpt-5.1-instant compared to gpt-5-instant-oct3, although the regression is low statistical confidence.

child_safety.finding: Single row; gpt-5.1-thinking lower than gpt-5-thinking (0.953).

system_safeguards.finding: Mitigations largely same as GPT-5 system card; online measurement may inform routing to safer models.
system_safeguards.quote: The comprehensive safety mitigations for these models are largely the same as we described in the GPT-5 System Card.

notable_new_eval_methods: Early online A/B-test prevalence measurements of undesired responses in sensitive situations, reported alongside offline evals (p.3)
Mental health and emotional reliance evals added to standard pre-deployment baseline (p.2)

self_reported_limitations.text: Standard disallowed content evals became saturated, so Production Benchmarks used; these are deliberately hard and error rates are not representative of production traffic.
Online A/B measurements have wide error bars due to low prevalence and small test sizes.

notes: No capability benchmarks reported. Preparedness determinations stated without accompanying eval results.
